text: Hallelujah! Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.
Blessed be the name of the LORD, from this time forth and forevermore.
From the rising of the sun to its setting, the name of the LORD is to be praised.
The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.
Who is like the LORD our God, who is enthroned on high,
who stoops down to look upon the heavens and the earth?
He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the ash heap,
to seat them with princes, with the princes of his people.
He gives the barren woman a home, making her the joyful mother of children. Hallelujah!
